name: date-picker
purpose: DatePicker picks **one date**, optionally with a time, in a form field. A trigger button opens a popover that holds a month grid, a typed date field (and a time field with `showTime`), an optional footer and an Apply action. The selection is staged in a draft inside the popover and committed to `v-model` only on Apply (or immediately when `show-apply` is false). Date math uses the native `Date` API only — no date library; the trigger formats the value with `Intl` in `v-model:time-zone` (the local zone when empty). Before 6.0 this component was `Calendar` and also picked ranges, periods and presets; every range — relative or absolute, with or without times — now belongs to `date-range-picker`, which reuses this component's month grid and fields as internal parts. The name follows Cloudscape DatePicker and the shadcn "Date Picker".
useWhen: Use DatePicker to pick one date (optionally with a time) in a form field. For any start–end range use DateRangePicker; to display a moment in time use Timestamp.
A due date, a start date, an expiry date, a birthday.
A date and a time of day together (`show-time`): a scheduled maintenance window start, a release time.
avoidWhen: A start and an end, whole days or with times, relative or absolute → use `date-range-picker`.
Displaying a date the person does not edit → use `timestamp`.
A duration or count (retention days, TTL) rather than a date → use `number-input`.
related: date-range-picker` — every range: relative windows (`last 15 minutes`) kept relative, absolute ranges down to the minute, and whole days with `:show-time="false"`. It is built on this component's grid, fields and time zone selector.
timestamp` — shows a moment in time in the app's time zone.
field` — inside a `Field`, the trigger takes the field's label (`for` points at it), description, `invalid` and `disabled`.
input` — the trigger and the date field share its heights, hover, and disabled treatment, so they align side by side.
bestPractices: modelValue` is committed only on Apply; read the final value from `update:modelValue` or the second argument of `apply`, and set `:show-apply="false"` when every edit should commit at once.
Bound the selectable days with `min` and `max` instead of validating after commit.
Send `toISOString()` (or the ISO date `2026-11-15`) to the server, never the printed label.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects the trigger, day-cell hit-area, and typography.

props.name: min
props.doc: Earliest selectable date; earlier days render disabled.

props.name: max
props.doc: Latest selectable date; later days render disabled.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the trigger, grid, and all controls, applying disabled tokens.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Marks the trigger invalid: sets `aria-invalid` and the danger border. An enclosing `Field`'s `invalid` sets it too.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Initial open state when uncontrolled (`v-model:open` unbound).

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Trigger text shown when there is no selection. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Select a date`).

props.name: showFields
props.doc: Shows the date field (and the time field with `showTime`) in the panel. Set false when the grid is the whole interaction and typing a date is not offered.

props.name: showTime
props.doc: Shows a time field beside the date field, so the value carries a time of day.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Places the fields and Apply column below the calendar (vertical) or beside it (horizontal).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the trigger; the current value is appended (`Due date: Nov 15, 2026`). Empty leaves the name to the Field label or the trigger text.

props.name: clearable
props.doc: Shows a clear control on the trigger that empties the committed selection.

props.name: showApply
props.doc: Stages edits in a draft and requires Apply to commit; when false, every edit commits immediately.

props.name: split
props.doc: Renders the trigger as a split control with a separate chevron affordance.

events.name: month-change
events.notes: Emitted when the first visible month changes via navigation or keyboard paging. Payload is `{ year, month }` (month is 0-indexed).

events.name: apply
events.notes: Emitted when the draft selection is committed via Apply; `event` is the activating click or key event, `value` the committed date.

slots.name: trigger
slots.notes: Replaces the default trigger button; scope exposes the open state, raw value, and formatted label.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DatePickerRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/date-picker-root'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const date = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DatePickerRoot
    v-model="date"
    aria-label="Start date"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Sizes
Horizontal
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DatePickerRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/date-picker-root'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const date = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DatePickerRoot
    v-model="date"
    orientation="horizontal"
    clearable
    show-time
  />
</template>
